EXCERPT: The statement ... shall be unnecessary where use is made of marks or certificates issued by the bodies notified by each Member State.
Member States may require that compliance ... shall be attested by marks or certificates issued on behalf of the competent authorities.
The file ... shall include a technical report or certificate, one or other obtained from a competent body.
Each Member State shall notify the Commission and the other Member States ... of the bodies responsible for issuing ... certificates.
The bodies designated by the Member States must fulfil ... technical competence ... independence ... professional secrecy ... civil liability insurance.
Member States shall notify ... the bodies ... designated for carrying out the certification, product checks, and associated surveillance tasks.
Member States shall inform the Commission of test laboratories ... designated for carrying out tests.
The notified body shall assess ... whether the quality control system ensures conformity of the products.
The notified body shall carry out audits at reasonable intervals ... and shall provide an audit report to the manufacturer.
An independent audit shall be performed ... and shall report its findings to the Commission. The auditor shall be appointed by the Registry.
The Registry shall select the validation agents in an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner.
Every applicant shall submit documentary evidence ... to a validation agent indicated by the Registry.
The relevant validation agent shall examine ... prior rights ... [and] notify the Registry accordingly.
The Registry shall ... enter into an agreement with ... an escrow agent ... designating the Commission as the beneficiary.
Complaints ... must be submitted to an ADR provider ... [which] shall inform the Registry ...; the Registry may select ADR providers.
Member States may exempt payment service providers ... provided that those organisations are subject to reporting and external audit requirements or supervision by ... a self-regulatory body.
Member States ... shall communicate to the Commission the measures ... including a list of organisations covered by the exemption.
An approved testing laboratory is a laboratory verified through the accreditation system and approved for conformity tests.
Member States shall notify approved laboratories and their scope for conformity tests.
A Member State may suspend recognition of a certificate after examining the specification and test results.
The Commission may seek the opinion of an approved laboratory and communicate it to Member States.
The national regulatory authority is legally distinct and functionally independent and is entrusted with regulatory functions.
The national regulatory authority shall keep detailed cost-accounting information and submit it to the Commission on request.
Member States notify the national regulatory authority; the authority makes available statistical reports and sends them to the Commission.
Judicial authorities may issue an injunction against an intermediary whose services are used by a third party to infringe an intellectual property right.
Rightholders shall be in a position to apply for an injunction against intermediaries whose services are used by a third party to infringe an intellectual property right.
Member States shall ensure appropriate measures against a person who was involved in an infringement without knowing it.
An author or performer retains a right to equitable remuneration, whose administration may be entrusted to collecting societies.
Member States may regulate whether and to what extent administration by collecting societies may be imposed.
Member States may derogate from the exclusive lending right provided that at least authors obtain remuneration.
Technical specifications include requirements concerning testing, test methods, packaging, marking and labelling.
The Community policy shall encourage the use of international standards and coordinate work with European standards institutions.
A committee assists the Commission in pursuing and managing the objectives and activities laid down by the Decision.
